name: Meg Meg's Happy Hubby Dating Sim!
source:
After the events of NND COMPASS: LIVE ARENA, you and Meg Meg have been happily married since! (Even despite it's absolutely depressing EOS...) And well, as she usually does, she's dragging you around and pushing you to go out on a super lovey dovey date with her! And, as her husband, it's your job to make sure she has the best date EVER! Otherwise, she'll probably kill you, herself, or everyone you love! Maybe all three! So make sure that crazy chick stays in check, m'kay!?
